title: Appraisal Order Surcharges and Visit Charges on a Mortgage Loan File Revised Loan Estimate
content:
A revised Loan Estimate on a Mortgage Loan File carries an appraisal surcharge line taken from the charges booked on the file's live primary Appraisal Order — the order placed on the file as a standard order, a transferred-in order or a new order after expiration that is not cancelled; a file carries at most one such order. Its appraisal fee charges are each recorded with the appraisal charge they concern.

**Rule.** Where the file's live primary appraisal order carries gross living area or acreage surcharge charges, those charges are added; where it carries neither but carries trip fee or reinspection fee charges, those charges are added; where it carries none of these charges, or the file has no live primary appraisal order, nothing is added.

| Charges booked on the Appraisal Order | Line |
|---|---|
| any gross living area surcharge or acreage surcharge charge | the total of the gross living area and acreage surcharge charges |
| no surcharge charge, but any trip fee or reinspection fee charge | the total of the trip fee and reinspection fee charges |
| none of these | nothing |
| no live primary appraisal order on the file | nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical Appraisal Order charges)

| Gross living area surcharge | Acreage surcharge | Trip fee | Reinspection fee | Line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 75.00 USD | 50.00 USD | 35.00 USD | — | 125.00 USD — the two surcharges; the trip fee is not added |
| — | 100.00 USD | — | 150.00 USD | 100.00 USD |
| — | — | 35.00 USD | 150.00 USD | 185.00 USD |
| — | — | — | — | nothing |
